question.stem: Which property of a mineral can be determined just by looking at it?
A student touches a metal spoon left in a pot of boiling water and finds that the spoon is hot. Which process transferred heat to the spoon?
Which of these best explains why the Moon has more craters than Earth?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The Moon has no atmosphere to burn up meteors.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The Moon is closer to the asteroid belt.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The Moon has active volcanoes that form craters.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The Moon has stronger gravity than Earth.
